## 4. Core Clinical Specialties & Protocols
1. **Restorative Dentistry & Endodontics (Terapiya)**: Complete curettage and filling of caries, pulpitis, and periodontitis using German (3M Filtek) and Japanese (Tokuyama Estelite) nanofilled composites under microscopic and digital apex locator control.
2. **Prosthodontics (Ortopediya)**: CAD/CAM monolithic zirconia crowns, ceramic bridges, and aesthetic inlays with natural translucency.
3. **Cosmetic Dentistry & E-max Veneers (Vinirlar)**: Minimal-prep porcelain veneers crafted with Swiss Ivoclar E-max, correcting tooth shade, alignment, gaps, and chips.
4. **Dental Implantology (Implantatsiya)**: Missing tooth restoration using biocompatible titanium fixtures (Osstem, Straumann) without shaving adjacent healthy teeth.
5. **Cold Laser Whitening & AirFlow Prophylaxis (Tish Oqartirish)**: Enamel-safe cold LED teeth whitening and ultrasonic cleaning.
6. **Atraumatic Extractions (Og'riqsiz Tish Olish)**: Gentle removal of wisdom teeth and roots preserving bone architecture.
7. **Digital 3D Radiovisiography (Rentgen)**: Low-radiation digital dental X-ray diagnostics delivering instant high-definition results in 2 seconds.

---

## 5. Clinical Safety & Warranties
- **100% Painless Anesthesia**: Two-stage topical spray/gel plus computerized local anesthetic delivery.
- **Class-B Hospital Sterilization**: European Class-B autoclave cycles; single-use kraft pouches unsealed directly before the patient. Strict compliance with Anti-HIV and Anti-Hepatitis protocols.
- **Formal Warranty**: Clinical warranty provided on all composite restorations, crowns, and veneers.
- **Official Online Booking**: https://drnozima.uz/booking (Direct connection to MedInson Clinic System).
